title: EAFIX Governance Defect Remediation Plan (Pre-Execution Gate for MASTER-V2)
objective: Remediate every governance, provenance, duplication, routing, and artifact-integrity defect identified by live repository audit, so that EAFIX-SSOT-REGISTRY-SYSTEM-MASTER-V2 can be lawfully ratified and executed on a verified baseline. This plan does not re-plan, re-sequence, or replace MASTER-V2. It is a bounded predecessor that removes the conditions which currently make MASTER-V2 ratification unsafe.

relationship_to_master_plan.rule: MASTER-V2 must not transition from proposed_pending_owner_ratification to ratified until this plan reaches definition_of_done or the owner explicitly waives a specific finding through the human_decision_register.
explicit_non_goals: Do not modify MASTER-V2 phase or task content except where PHASE-01 requires a provenance correction.
Do not execute any MASTER-V2 phase.
Do not perform registry conflict burn-down, authority cutover, or repository migration.
Do not populate registry data content beyond what a finding explicitly requires.

mandatory_routing_and_authority.human_authority: Dick (GitHub: DICKY1987) is the sole decision authority for every human_decision_register gate in this plan.
mandatory_routing_and_authority.unresolved_authority_notice: This plan treats the doc-authority question as OPEN. Two doc_authority.json files exist with contradictory self-descriptions and incompatible schemas (see FND-04). No task in this plan may cite either file as settled authority until HD-03 is decided.
mandatory_routing_and_authority.push_credentials_note: Deliverables are produced as git format-patch / git am compatible artifacts. The executing agent does not push to protected branches.

classes.E1_CODE: Primary. Executable source or tooling read directly from the repository at a named commit.
classes.E2_ARTIFACT: Primary. A committed file's actual bytes, hash, or parsed content read at a named commit.
classes.E3_AUTHORITY: Corroboration only. An authority document's assertion about the world. Confidence capped at medium. Never sufficient alone to close a finding.
classes.E4_HISTORICAL: Supporting. Git history, commit messages, prior reports.
classes.E5_JUDGEMENT: Architectural or governance decision. Must be attributed to a named human decision gate.

prohibitions: Resolution by transcription: restating an authority claim as if it were verified fact.
Normalization laundering: reformatting a defective record and declaring it repaired.
Inventing reconciled interfaces, hashes, counts, or file contents that were not observed.
Deleting a reference, record, or file solely to make a validator pass.
Marking a finding resolved on E3_AUTHORITY evidence alone.
evidence_protocol.honesty_audit_metric: Report the ratio of findings closed on E1/E2 evidence to findings closed on E3-only or E5-only evidence. A high E3/E5 ratio is a quality warning, not a success signal.

audit_provenance.method: Full-depth git clone of master, byte-level sha256 comparison, whole-tree grep, and direct JSON parse.

problem_register.title: vNext atomic module catalog is empty, and three sources disagree on the module universe (27 vs 34 vs 0)
verified_observation: EAFIX_auth_docs/02_module_architecture_and_atomic_migration/Claude_gen_atomic_module_catalog_vNext.json parses; modules is a list of length 0.
module_registry.jsonl holds 34 records with module_id 50000000000000000001 through 50000000000000000034.
module_catalog.json holds 27 entries. Set comparison shows these are 26 atomic modules (…0001 through …0026), every one present in the registry, PLUS one outlier …0099 = SHARED_LIBS.
The registry's 34 are a clean superset of the catalog's 26 atomic modules, adding eight (…0027 through …0034).
So the true comparison is 26 atomic plus one non-atomic bucket versus 34 atomic, not 27 versus 34.

Corroboration: process_registry.jsonl holds exactly 26 records, and CONFLICT::PROCESS_COVERAGE records the process catalog models 26 of 34 modules. The 26 are the original universe; eight were added later.
SHARED_LIBS (…0099) carries layer=unassigned, empty scope_in and scope_out, and purpose 'owns cross-cutting shared libraries', marking it a different kind of entity from an atomic trading module.
registry_conflict_queue.jsonl already logs this as CONFLICT::MODULE_UNIVERSE (27 records vs 34 in the manifest migration layer).
problem_register.why_it_matters: MASTER-V2 PHASE-06 ratifies the 34-module identity universe. It cannot ratify against an empty array, and it cannot ratify while the universe count is disputed. Set arithmetic dissolves the dispute, but the resolution must be recorded and the vNext array populated from a verified source, not reconstructed by inference.

problem_register.title: Archival operations do not write back to doc_authority, leaving canonical documents declared as routable while stored in the do-not-route archive
verified_observation: Commit e846d04a (Archive project knowledge routing instructions, PR #83) moved eafix_project_knowledge_reference_routing_instructions.json into 99_archive_superseded_do_not_route/.
The 00_doc_control_and_authority/doc_authority.json entry for that file still classifies it authority_level 1 canonical and describes it as the single authoritative copy at repository root.
The same contradiction exists for EAFIX_auth_docs/Y_module governance glossary.json: declared authority_level 1 canonical, physically in the archive.

Because the cause is a missing process step, fixing only the two records would leave the next archival move to reintroduce the defect.

human_decision_register.title: Disposition of the unverifiable MASTER-V2 provenance sources
human_decision_register.question: Two cited source documents (remediation v1.1.0 and amendment v1.0.1) have never existed in repository history. How is MASTER-V2's provenance to be made truthful?

options.label: Locate and commit
options.description: Owner produces the two files from an external location. Their sha256 is verified against the cited values, they are committed, and provenance is confirmed intact.
options.consequence: Strongest outcome. MASTER-V2 provenance becomes fully verifiable. No plan content changes.

options.label: Correct provenance to observed reality
options.description: Amend MASTER-V2 source_plan_consolidation to remove the two unverifiable sources, reduce source_count from 13 to 11, recompute unique_content_hash_count, and add an explicit provenance_gap_note recording that the v1.1.0 lineage could not be substantiated.
options.consequence: MASTER-V2 sha256 changes and the verification spec must be re-bound in the same commit. ADDITIONALLY: the obligation matrix carries 13 positional JSON pointers /source_plan_consolidation/sources/0..12. The two removed sources are at indices 2 and 3, so deletion shifts indices 4..12 down by two and leaves /sources/11 and /sources/12 dangling, corrupting 11 of 13 pointers and forcing an obligation-matrix regeneration. This makes B the most expensive option, not the cleanest.

options.label: Ratify with recorded exception
options.description: Leave MASTER-V2 bytes unchanged. Record a standing governance exception naming FND-01, and require any MASTER-V2 phase whose content derives from the v1.1.0 lineage to re-derive its justification from E1/E2 evidence before execution.
options.consequence: Preserves the hash binding and avoids churn, but leaves an unverifiable assertion inside the root authority document.

options.label: Mark unverifiable in place (preserve array indices)
options.description: Retain source array indices 2 and 3. Set each entry's disposition to unverifiable_absent_from_repository_history, attach the git-history absence evidence, and rewrite the GATE-AUTHORITY-PARITY-TOOL note so it no longer rests on the unverifiable document. Re-bind the verification spec target_plan in the same commit.
options.consequence: Achieves HD-01-C's structural safety and HD-01-B's honesty at once. The array keeps its shape so all 13 obligation pointers continue to resolve, while the record now states the truth. MASTER-V2 bytes change, so the verification spec target_plan.sha256 and byte_size MUST be updated in the same commit.

human_decision_register.prohibition: The executing agent must not select an option, must not fabricate the missing files, and must not synthesize content matching the cited hashes.

recommended_disposition.recommendation: Attempt HD-01-A recovery first, time-boxed. On failure, apply HD-01-D rather than HD-01-B or HD-01-C.
recommended_disposition.note: Recommendation only. This gate remains open until the owner records a decision.

human_decision_register.title: Canonical filename for MASTER-V2 and archival destination for superseded plans
human_decision_register.question: Which single filename is canonical for MASTER-V2, and where do the eleven superseded source plans go?

options.label: Bind to the spec-named file
options.description: Retain EAFIX_SSOT_REGISTRY_SYSTEM_FINAL_MERGED_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v2_0_0.json (the bare form already named in the verification spec target_plan.filename). Delete the four Chat_/Final_ prefixed duplicates.
options.consequence: Zero downstream reference churn. Recommended on evidence: the verification spec already names this exact filename.

options.label: Bind to a different filename
options.description: Owner names an alternative canonical filename. All references, including verification spec target_plan.filename, are updated in the same change.
options.consequence: Requires coordinated reference update; higher risk.

sub_decision.question: Destination for the eleven superseded source plans.

options.label: 99_archive_superseded_do_not_route/
options.description: Move all superseded plans there and register each in archive_manifest.json with reviewer_decision set to approved.

options.label: superseded/
options.description: Use the existing EAFIX_auth_docs/superseded/ folder, which already holds four superseded documents.

options.label: Retain in place with metadata only
options.description: Leave files where they are and add supersession metadata sidecar records. Lowest disruption, weakest routing protection.

human_decision_register.prohibition: No file may be deleted before the owner records a decision. Deletion of the four duplicates is lawful only because their bytes are provably identical to the retained file; the agent must re-verify hash equality immediately before deletion.

recommended_disposition.recommendation: HD-02-A (bare filename, already named by the verification spec) plus ARC-A (99_archive_superseded_do_not_route, the only governed archive with a manifest and routing policy).

human_decision_register.title: Which doc_authority.json is canonical
human_decision_register.question: Two doc_authority.json files exist with contradictory self-descriptions and incompatible schemas. Which is canonical, and what happens to the other?

options.label: 00_doc_control_and_authority copy is canonical
options.description: It has 24 entries versus 5, was updated during a documented governance recovery exercise, sits in the folder named for doc control, and explicitly claims sole authority. Delete or archive the root copy and update authority_and_supersession_checklist.md step 1 to point at it.
options.consequence: Honours the file's own claim. Requires updating the checklist and any consumer expecting the root path.

options.label: Root copy is canonical
options.description: It is dated one day later and matches the path already named in authority_and_supersession_checklist.md step 1. Its 5 entries must first be reconciled against the 24 in the other file so no authority record is lost.
options.consequence: Requires a documented merge of 24 entries into the 5-entry schema before the other file is archived. Higher effort, higher risk of silent record loss.

options.label: Merge into one new canonical file
options.description: Produce a single reconciled doc_authority.json adopting one schema, containing the union of all entries, with every merge decision recorded.
options.consequence: Cleanest end state, highest effort. Requires a per-entry reconciliation record.

human_decision_register.prohibition: Neither file may be edited, moved, or deleted before this decision is recorded. The agent must not infer canonicity from file modification date alone.

recommended_disposition.recommendation: HD-03-C merge, canonical at the 00_doc_control_and_authority location. The schemas are compatible (00_ is a strict superset), the union is 28 entries with zero conflicts, and the files are functionally complementary.
recommended_disposition.note: Recommendation only. Corrects the v1.0.0 assumption that merge was high-effort.

human_decision_register.title: Authoritative source for the 34 module identities
human_decision_register.question: The vNext catalog declares 34 modules but holds an empty array. From which verified source are the 34 identities to be populated?

options.label: Populate from module_registry.jsonl
options.description: Derive the 34 catalog entries from the 34 records already present in module_registry.jsonl, which is the authored registry authority.
options.consequence: Consistent with the registry-as-authority model. Requires a field-mapping record showing exactly which registry field populates which catalog field.

options.label: Populate from an external authored source
options.description: Owner supplies the authored 34-module catalog content from outside the repository. Contents are committed and hash-recorded.
options.consequence: Requires provenance evidence for the supplied content.

options.label: Retire the vNext catalog
options.description: Declare Claude_gen_atomic_module_catalog_vNext.json superseded by module_registry.jsonl, archive it, and remove it from routing.
options.consequence: Eliminates the dual-authority problem entirely. Requires confirming that no consumer depends on the catalog's distinct schema.

human_decision_register.prohibition: The agent must not populate the modules array by inference, reconstruction, or transcription from prose documents. If HD-04-A is selected, every populated field must trace to a named registry field.

recommended_disposition.recommendation: HD-04-A. Universe = registry ids …0001 through …0034. Classify SHARED_LIBS (…0099) as a non-atomic cross-cutting bucket outside the 34. This also closes CONFLICT::MODULE_UNIVERSE.

human_decision_register.title: Disposition of stale .state execution evidence
human_decision_register.question: The .state trail is completed historical state from a prior workstream, containing machine-specific absolute paths. What is its disposition?

options.label: Annotate in place
options.description: Add .state/WORKSTREAM_PROVENANCE.md recording the workstream identity, date range, completed status, and an explicit statement that it is unrelated to the SSOT registry plans. Change no evidence files.
options.consequence: Preserves the audit trail intact. Recommended default: minimal, reversible, and matches proportionality.

options.label: Archive the tree
options.description: Move .state to an archive location with a manifest.
options.consequence: Reduces confusion but may break any tooling that reads .state.
options.disqualification_reason: Disqualified, not merely less-preferred. .state is the live write target for the verification package: the evidence manifest run_root_contract template is .state/verification/{run_id}/ and generate_eafix_ssot_registry_verification_package.py computes run_root = root/.state/verification/run_id at line 588. Relocating .state breaks the verification run root before it is exercised. Eleven files across the repository reference .state paths.

options.label: Leave untouched
options.description: Record the finding as accepted risk and take no action.
options.consequence: Zero effort; the misreading risk persists.

human_decision_register.prohibition: The agent must not sanitize, rewrite, or delete historical evidence records. The absolute Windows paths are part of the historical record and must be annotated, not edited.

recommended_disposition.recommendation: HD-05-A annotate in place. HD-05-B is disqualified: .state is the live verification run root.

human_decision_register.title: Ratification of MASTER-V2 for execution
human_decision_register.question: With all remediation complete, is MASTER-V2 ratified for execution, and does its status change from proposed_pending_owner_ratification?

options.label: Ratify
options.description: All findings closed or explicitly waived. MASTER-V2 status transitions to ratified_for_execution. The verification spec binding is confirmed current.

options.label: Ratify with scoped exceptions
options.description: Ratify while naming specific findings as accepted risk, each with a rationale and a review date.

options.label: Withhold ratification
options.description: One or more findings remain unacceptable. Plan returns to remediation with named blockers.

human_decision_register.prohibition: The agent must never set MASTER-V2 status to ratified without a recorded HD-06 decision, and must never report this plan complete while any finding is open and unwaived.

recommended_disposition.recommendation: HD-06 cannot be pre-decided; it is the output of execution. The RULE is pre-committed: ratify only if all four conditions hold, with the hash binding and the dangling-reference scan non-waivable.

write_scopes.rule: Each task declares the exact paths it may create, modify, or delete. Any write outside a task's declared scope is a plan violation and must abort the task.
write_scopes.global_prohibition_rationale: Authored registry data, generated projections, registry tooling, and CI are owned by MASTER-V2 phases. This plan repairs governance metadata only. EA-REG, services, and compliance are entirely out of scope.

phases.title: Freeze the baseline and re-verify every finding before any write
phases.gate_rule: No task in any later phase may begin until every PHASE-00 task reports a verdict. If any finding fails to reproduce, STOP and report the divergence. Do not proceed on a stale audit.

tasks.action: Capture and freeze the working baseline.
method: git clone https://github.com/DICKY1987/eafix-modular.git && cd eafix-modular
git fetch --unshallow || true
git rev-parse HEAD
Record HEAD commit sha, commit date, and branch.
acceptance_criteria: HEAD sha recorded.
If HEAD differs from 43f0962, every PHASE-00 verification task must still be run and any divergence reported before proceeding.
evidence_required: Explicit statement of whether HEAD matches the audit baseline.
tasks.failure_handling: If the clone or fetch fails, abort the plan. Do not work from a partial tree.

tasks.action: Re-verify FND-01: confirm the two cited provenance sources exist nowhere in history.
method: git log --all --diff-filter=ADMR --name-only --format='COMMIT %h %ci' | grep -iE 'REMEDIATION_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v1_1_0|PLAN_AMENDMENT_v1_0_1' | sort -u
find . -path ./.git -prune -o -iname '*REMEDIATION*' -print -o -iname '*AMENDMENT*' -print
Parse MASTER-V2 source_plan_consolidation.sources and list every source whose canonical_filename does not resolve on disk.
acceptance_criteria: Verdict recorded: sources absent from all history (confirms FND-01) or found (FND-01 refuted).
Exact list of unresolvable source filenames with their cited sha256 values.
tasks.failure_handling: If the files ARE found, mark FND-01 refuted, verify their sha256 against the cited values, and skip PHASE-01 tasks GOV-011 onward.

tasks.action: Re-verify FND-02 and FND-03: duplicate and superseded document inventory.
method: sha256sum EAFIX_auth_docs/*FINAL_MERGED_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v2_0_0.json
For each of the 13 MASTER-V2 declared sources, resolve its canonical_filename on disk and record path, sha256, and declared disposition.
For each resolved file, test whether it carries supersession metadata keys (status, superseded_by, reason, active_authority).
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate set enumerated with hashes proving identity.
Table of source filename, on-disk path, declared disposition, supersession metadata present true or false.
tasks.failure_handling: If any two supposed duplicates differ in hash, escalate immediately. Non-identical copies are a different and more serious problem than duplication.

tasks.action: Re-verify FND-04 and FND-05: doc authority collision and control-file path resolution.
method: Parse both doc_authority.json files. Record generated_at, updated_at, entry count, schema key set, and any self-authority claim.
For every path named in control_files and in authority_and_supersession_checklist.md step 1, test existence and record the actual location if found elsewhere.

tasks.action: Present the ratification decision and apply the recorded outcome.
method: Present the final report, the closure ratio, and any waived findings to the owner for HD-06.
On HD-06-A or HD-06-B, update MASTER-V2 status from proposed_pending_owner_ratification to the owner-recorded value, and record any scoped exceptions.
If the status edit changes MASTER-V2 bytes, update the verification spec target_plan binding in the SAME commit and re-run the validator.
On HD-06-C, record the named blockers and return the plan to remediation.
acceptance_criteria: MASTER-V2 status reflects the recorded decision and no other value.
If bytes changed, the spec binding was updated in the same commit and the validator passes.
Every waived finding has a rationale and a review date.
evidence_required: Validator output if the hash changed.
tasks.failure_handling: Never set the status to ratified without a recorded HD-06 decision. Never change plan bytes without re-binding the spec in the same commit.

parallel_allowed.rationale: These three phases touch disjoint write scopes (documentation_triage_matrix, module catalog, .state) and share no decision gate.

execution_order.critical_path: PHASE-00 -> HD-01 -> PHASE-01 -> HD-02 -> PHASE-02 -> HD-03 -> PHASE-03 -> HD-06 -> PHASE-07
execution_order.note: PHASE-04 has no human decision gate and can start immediately after PHASE-00. It is the cheapest early win.

validation_catalog.name: Governance artifact parseability
validation_catalog.rule: Every .json file under EAFIX_auth_docs loads with json.load and every .jsonl line loads with json.loads.

validation_catalog.name: Source resolvability
validation_catalog.rule: Every source declared in MASTER-V2 source_plan_consolidation resolves to an existing file, or is removed with a recorded provenance gap, or is covered by a recorded exception.

validation_catalog.name: Plan-to-spec hash binding
validation_catalog.rule: Verification spec target_plan.sha256 and byte_size equal the recomputed values of the file named in target_plan.filename.

validation_catalog.name: Canonical uniqueness
validation_catalog.rule: Exactly one file matching *FINAL_MERGED_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v2_0_0.json exists under EAFIX_auth_docs.

validation_catalog.name: Control-file resolvability
validation_catalog.rule: Every path in the canonical doc_authority.json control_files exists, and none resolves inside 99_archive_superseded_do_not_route.

validation_catalog.name: Single doc authority
validation_catalog.rule: Exactly one doc_authority.json is designated canonical and declares that status in-file; any other copy carries supersession metadata.

validation_catalog.name: No dangling references to archived content
validation_catalog.rule: No active document references a path that has been moved to an archive or superseded location.

validation_catalog.name: Module identity consistency
validation_catalog.rule: If the vNext catalog is retained, len(modules) equals the module_registry.jsonl record count of 34, and every populated field traces to a named source field.

validation_catalog.name: Historical evidence immutability
validation_catalog.rule: No pre-existing file under .state is modified or deleted by this plan.

validation_catalog.name: Write scope containment
validation_catalog.rule: Every changed path in every PR appears in the declared write_scope of a task in that PR's phases.

validation_catalog.name: Registry data untouched
validation_catalog.rule: No file under EAFIX_auth_docs/01_canonical_registries/*.jsonl, EAFIX_auth_docs/generated/, tools/registries/, EA-REG/, services/, or compliance/ is modified by this plan.

validation_catalog.name: Verification package remains unexecuted
validation_catalog.rule: The evidence manifest document_state remains unexecuted_template and the report report_status remains not_run. This plan does not run verification.

validation_catalog.name: Obligation pointer integrity
validation_catalog.rule: Every /source_plan_consolidation/sources/N pointer in the obligation matrix resolves to an existing source entry. If sources were removed (HD-01-B), the matrix was regenerated; if marked in place (HD-01-D), indices are unchanged.

validation_catalog.name: No canonical document in the do-not-route archive
validation_catalog.rule: No document classified canonical in the merged doc_authority resolves to a path inside 99_archive_superseded_do_not_route/, and the archival write-back rule is present in the checklist.

validation_catalog.name: Atomic universe excludes SHARED_LIBS
validation_catalog.rule: If the vNext catalog is populated, its 34 entries are …0001 through …0034 and do not include SHARED_LIBS (…0099); SHARED_LIBS, if present anywhere in the atomic set, is separately classified non-atomic.

required: All ten findings in the problem_register have a terminal disposition of closed or waived, with no finding open.
Every closure cites E1_CODE or E2_ARTIFACT evidence, or names the human decision gate that authorised an E5_JUDGEMENT closure.
All twelve validations in the validation_catalog pass.
All six human decision gates have a recorded decision with a rationale.
Exactly one canonical MASTER-V2 file and exactly one canonical doc_authority.json exist.
Every governance JSON and JSONL artifact under EAFIX_auth_docs parses.
The verification spec target_plan binding matches the canonical plan file's actual bytes.
The authority_and_supersession_checklist has been executed end to end with all ten steps recorded.
No file under any globally prohibited path has been modified.
The honesty audit ratio has been reported.
MASTER-V2 status reflects the recorded HD-06 decision.
No canonical document resolves inside the do-not-route archive, and the archival write-back rule is in the checklist (VAL-14).
The atomic module universe is exactly the 34 registry ids …0001 through …0034, excluding SHARED_LIBS (VAL-15).
explicitly_not_required: Running the verification package to produce verdicts.
Changing registry_index.json authority_status from canonical_candidate or approved_for_cutover from false.
Any repository migration or file move outside EAFIX_auth_docs and .state.

Resolving the registry_conflict_queue.jsonl records, EXCEPT that CONFLICT::MODULE_UNIVERSE becomes closeable as a byproduct of the HD-04 identity resolution in PHASE-05. The other ten conflicts remain MASTER-V2 PHASE-04 work.

failure_handling.fail_closed_default: On any ambiguity, stop and report. Do not proceed on an assumption.
hard_stops: Two files believed identical have different hashes.
A merge or archival step would reduce authority-record coverage without a recorded rationale for each omission.
A MASTER-V2 byte change is proposed without a paired verification spec re-binding in the same commit.
Resolution of a finding would require creating a file, hash, count, or record that was never observed.
A write is attempted outside the executing task's declared write_scope.
Three or more findings fail to reproduce at PHASE-00, indicating a stale audit.
prohibited_recoveries: Deleting a reference to silence a validator.
Reformatting a governance artifact to make it parse.
Populating a field by inference to satisfy a count assertion.
Marking a finding closed on E3_AUTHORITY evidence alone.
Editing historical evidence to remove machine-specific paths.
Reporting the plan complete while any finding is open and unwaived.
failure_handling.escalation: Any hard stop returns to the owner with the observed state, the expected state, the evidence for both, and the options available. The agent proposes; it does not decide.

before_each_task: Restate the task_id, its declared write_scope, and any conditional_on gate.
Confirm the gating human decision has been recorded, if the task declares one.
Confirm the current branch is under copilot/*.
during_each_task: Verify every claim against the repository before asserting it.
Record the evidence class for each assertion.
Abort immediately on any write outside the declared scope.
after_each_task: Report acceptance criteria as met or not met, individually and explicitly.
List every path changed and confirm each appears in the declared write_scope.

required_sections: Findings table: finding_id, disposition (closed/waived/open), closing evidence class.
Honesty audit: count of E1/E2 closures versus E3-only and E5-only closures, expressed as a ratio.
Validation results: all twelve validations with pass or fail.
Human decisions: all six gates with the recorded decision, or explicitly marked awaiting decision.
Changed-path inventory with the authorising task_id for each path.
Hash ledger: before and after sha256 for MASTER-V2, the verification spec, and every modified governance artifact.
Residual risk: everything not fixed, with the reason.
Explicit statement of what was NOT done, referencing definition_of_done.explicitly_not_required.
prohibited_claims: Claiming the plan is complete while any finding is open and unwaived.
Claiming a finding is verified when it was closed on authority assertion alone.
Claiming MASTER-V2 is ratified without a recorded HD-06 decision.
Claiming verification was performed. This plan does not run the verification package.
Presenting an E5_JUDGEMENT closure as equivalent to an E1/E2 closure.
agent_final_response_contract.required_disclosure: If any acceptance criterion was met by changing the criterion rather than the artifact, say so explicitly and prominently.

out_of_scope: All seventeen MASTER-V2 phases (PHASE-00 through PHASE-16).
Registry conflict burn-down: the conflict_queue records, EXCEPT CONFLICT::MODULE_UNIVERSE which PHASE-05 resolves as a byproduct of HD-04. The remaining conflicts stay in MASTER-V2 PHASE-04.
Authority cutover and any change to registry_index.json approved_for_cutover.
Repository migration and the 34-module folder restructure.
Any change inside EA-REG/, services/, compliance/, tools/, or .github/.
Executing the verification package to produce verdicts.

supersedes.reason: Folds in owner-decision recommendations DEC-REG-015 through DEC-REG-021 and the verification evidence that produced them. Three changes were material: a new HD-01 fallback option D, a corrected HD-03 effort/feasibility characterisation, and HD-05-B reclassified as disqualified.

revision_log.change: HD-01: added option HD-01-D (mark unverifiable sources in place, preserving array indices) and new task GOV-013 implementing it. Rationale: obligation matrix carries 13 positional pointers /source_plan_consolidation/sources/0..12; the unverifiable sources are at indices 2 and 3, so deletion (HD-01-B) corrupts 11 of 13 pointers.

HD-03: corrected characterisation. The two doc_authority files were assumed to have incompatible schemas making merge high-effort. Verified: 00_ schema is a strict superset of root schema, entry overlap is exactly one document with agreeing values, union is 28 entries with zero conflicts. Merge (HD-03-C) is now the recommended default, not the costly fallback. The files are complementary, not duplicative.

HD-05: HD-05-B (archive the tree) reclassified from less-preferred to DISQUALIFIED. .state is the live verification run root: evidence manifest run_root_contract template is .state/verification/{run_id}/ and the generator computes run_root under .state at line 588. Archiving would break the verification package.

FND-08 / HD-04: the 27-vs-34 module conflict is resolved by set arithmetic. Catalog's 27 = 26 atomic (…0001-…0026, all in registry) + SHARED_LIBS (…0099). Registry's 34 = …0001-…0034. Corroborated by process_registry.jsonl holding exactly 26. Closes CONFLICT::MODULE_UNIVERSE.

FND-05 / FND-04: added FND-11, a systematic archival write-back defect. Commit e846d04a (PR #83) archived a canonical L1 document without updating its doc_authority record, which still calls it canonical at repository root. Same pattern for the Y_ glossary. PHASE-03 gains a process-repair task GOV-034.
Added recommended_disposition field to each of HD-01..HD-06 pointing at the companion decision record. These are recommendations; the gates remain open until the owner records a decision.
